title: Choose Aimprove's new look
question: The roll picked Story Cards. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Story Cards
options.lineage: Year-end listening recaps and phone story slides
options.thesis: Your study day told as a stack of loud story cards, each with one giant number.
options.viewport: Today is a vertical stack of colour cards: a lime streak card with the day ring, a blue Reviews card and a pink Lessons card with huge counts, and a calm emerald Quran card.
options.risk: Can tip into noisy if every screen shouts; the quiet screens (Quran page, Settings) must stay plain.

raised.raise: Fixed-scale stage strip: Sabaq to Manzil and Apprentice to Burned drawn on one baseline at one scale, so progress compares at a glance.
One message per card: each card states one next action and its number, nothing competing.
Whole-cell grid: the 604-page Mushaf map and the level grid reflow by whole cells on a strict 8pt armature.
Fixed tonal ramp: every tint comes from a five-step ramp per field colour, never ad-hoc opacity.

options.label: Stamp Card
options.lineage: Rajio taiso summer stamp cards and pesantren setoran cards
options.thesis: Every study day earns a stamp, like the attendance cards both cultures already know.
options.viewport: Today opens on this week's stamp card, with a row of seven day boxes and today's box empty until reviews are done; below it, Reviews and Lessons buttons and the Quran setoran list.
options.risk: Familiar paper-and-stamp look; can read cute or childish rather than Gen Z.

options.label: Departures Board
options.lineage: Boarding pass and live gate board
options.thesis: Today's queue is a departures board: everything ranked by when it's due.
options.viewport: A dark board lists rows like 'NOW Reviews 23 — boarding' and '05:00 Manzil p.582'; tapping a row opens its pass.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: the due-time queue and forecast map to a ranked board. Holds product clarity, but loses on Gen Z identification.
options.risk: Travel metaphor can feel like a costume if rows aren't standard list rows.

options.label: Fajr Star Chart
options.thesis: Memory strength drawn as star magnitude: the Mushaf and levels as a night sky you light up.
options.viewport: A navy Today screen with a sky strip of 604 dots (bigger means stronger), then Reviews and Lessons counts and today's Quran pages.
options.case: Strong for the Mushaf map (dot size equals stability) and the pre-Fajr scene; dark-only conflicts with your light-only choice.
options.risk: Dark, quiet and moody; less playful than asked.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Each page and item grows from bud to husk.
options.viewport: Fixed-scale stage plates in a row.
options.case: Cream and italic serif don't read as young; loses on both axes.

options.label: Terminal Yellow
options.thesis: One yellow band names the next study step.
options.case: Clear, but cold and corporate for this audience.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Everything built cell by cell on a visible grid.
options.case: Poster logic, not a daily habit app.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.case: Niche and technical for this audience.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The gamified language-app look, done properly.
canonCard.viewport: A streak counter and XP bar on top, a winding lesson path, and a big green Start button.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other learning app by design.
